description: Business plans: a rotation through notification contacts (list_notification_contacts), handing off daily or weekly at a time in a time zone. The first member is on call from now. Free.

handoff_day.description: Weekly handoffs: the weekday, 1 for Monday.

handoff_time.description: HH:MM on the schedule's own clock.

member_ids.description: Notification contacts (GET /alert-channels) in rotation order. Changing them, the rotation, the handoff or the time zone starts the rotation over with the first member.

rotation.description: How often on call passes to the next member.
